_note: Practice library for knowledge_fabric/reasoning.py. Generic, widely used industrial / refinery improvement actions - NOT company facts. Each action is matched to a driver that the company's own evidence supports; its expected impact is described qualitatively and must be quantified from the company's data (field data_required). Edit freely: add your organisation's standard actions, owners and review cadences.

maintenance_cost.label: rising maintenance cost / repeated equipment failures

actions.action: Rank equipment by maintenance cost over the analysis period (Pareto) and run a formal root-cause analysis on every repeat failure among the top ten
actions.expected_impact: fewer repeat failures on the highest-cost equipment; lower corrective maintenance spend
actions.risk: RCA findings not closed out; failure coding too poor to rank reliably
actions.kpi: maintenance cost per unit of throughput; repeat-failure count
actions.data_required: work orders, cost per work order, failure mode per equipment tag
actions.success_condition: repeat failures on the top-ten list reduced quarter on quarter for two consecutive quarters

actions.action: Move critical rotating equipment from breakdown to condition-based maintenance (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) with defined alarm limits
actions.expected_impact: breakdowns caught earlier; planned instead of emergency repairs
actions.risk: alarms ignored without a response procedure
actions.kpi: share of planned vs unplanned work orders; MTBF of critical equipment
actions.success_condition: planned work share rising and MTBF of critical equipment improving over two quarters

actions.action: Review spares inventory: remove slow-moving stock, set min/max levels for critical spares, renegotiate high-value spares contracts
actions.expected_impact: lower spares holding cost without stock-outs on critical items
actions.data_required: inventory register with consumption per item
actions.success_condition: inventory value down with zero critical stock-outs

actions.action: Run a bad-actor elimination programme on the units and equipment with the most unplanned downtime hours
actions.expected_impact: recovered production hours on the worst performers
actions.data_required: downtime events with duration and cause per unit
actions.success_condition: unplanned downtime on bad actors reduced for two consecutive quarters

actions.action: Optimise turnaround scope and duration using risk-based inspection results
actions.expected_impact: shorter planned outages and fewer post-turnaround failures
actions.risk: scope cut on equipment that later fails
actions.data_required: RBI results, turnaround work lists and durations
actions.success_condition: next turnaround on schedule with no scope-related failures in six months

energy.label: high energy consumption / fuel and loss

actions.action: Commission an energy audit (furnaces, steam system, steam traps, flare) and implement the no-cost and low-cost measures first
dependencies: metered fuel, steam and power data
actions.expected_impact: lower fuel and loss and energy intensity
actions.risk: savings not verified because metering is missing
actions.kpi: Energy Intensity Index; fuel and loss %
actions.data_required: fuel, steam and power consumption per unit
actions.success_condition: EII and fuel & loss below the audited baseline for two quarters

margin.label: margin squeeze (crude cost vs product realisation)

actions.action: Re-optimise the crude basket and product slate with the refinery LP model against current prices; review the price-risk (hedging) policy
actions.expected_impact: higher gross refining margin for the same throughput
actions.risk: model not calibrated to actual yields
actions.data_required: crude and product prices, unit yields, crude assays
actions.success_condition: GRM gap to benchmark narrowing over two quarters

actions.action: Carry out a debottlenecking study of the constraining unit and act on the low-capex items
actions.risk: bottleneck moves to the next unit
actions.data_required: unit loads, constraints log, test-run data
actions.success_condition: capacity utilisation above baseline for two quarters after the change

actions.action: Refinance high-cost borrowings and set a working-capital reduction target (inventory days, receivable days)
actions.expected_impact: lower interest cost and cash tied up in operations
actions.data_required: debt schedule with rates; inventory and receivable days
actions.success_condition: interest cost and working-capital days below baseline for two quarters

actions.action: Close all open incident-investigation actions and run a process-safety gap assessment against the applicable standard
actions.kpi: TRIR; open investigation actions; loss of containment events
actions.data_required: incident register with actions and status
actions.success_condition: no overdue investigation actions; incident rate below baseline

actions.action: Review customer and product mix: rank products by contribution margin and shift volume towards the highest-margin outlets
actions.kpi: contribution margin by product; revenue per tonne
actions.data_required: sales and margin by product and customer
actions.success_condition: contribution margin above baseline for two quarters

data_foundation.action: Close the data gaps before deciding: collect the missing years, departments and document types listed in the coverage report
data_foundation.expected_impact: the analysis can move from partial to complete evidence
data_foundation.risk: decisions taken on an incomplete record
data_foundation.kpi: years and departments covered in the knowledge base
data_foundation.data_required: the documents listed as MISSING in the coverage report
data_foundation.success_condition: coverage report shows the analysis period as AVAILABLE
